meta.name: content-research-writer
meta.description: 内容创作者、技术写作员在撰写博客、深度文章或技术文档时，使用此技能可开启全流程写作协作。它能帮你研究资料、构建大纲、逐段打磨并自动添加引用，快速优化Hook，让你高效产出高质量内容，告别孤军奋战！

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 产出带引用、逐段打磨的内容作品
copy.fit_line: 适合你,如果写长文时总是卡在资料整理和打磨上
copy.tagline_en: Research, structure, and polish articles with citations
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you often get stuck on research and polishing when writing long articles.

howto.what: 写作时它会陪你列大纲、查资料并加引用、改写开头、逐段给反馈,并保留你原有的语气风格。
howto.when: 当你写博客、技术文档等长文,或要求做大纲、查资料加引用、改开头时接管。

say.text: 帮我为这篇文章列一个大纲
say.note: 它会先问主题、受众和风格再给结构

say.text: 查一下这个话题的近期数据,并加到我的大纲里
say.note: 输出要点、来源和格式化的引用

say.text: 这是我的开头,帮我改得更有吸引力
say.note: 分析现有开头并给出几个备选写法

howto.what_en: Once installed, it writes alongside you on long-form pieces: outlines, research with citations, hook rewrites, section feedback, and keeping your own voice.
howto.when_en: Use it when writing blog posts, technical docs, or similar long pieces, or when you ask for an outline, sourced citations, or hook feedback.

say_en.text: Help me create an outline for this article.
say_en.note: It asks about topic, audience, and style first.

say_en.text: Research this topic and add citations to my outline.
say_en.note: Returns key findings, sources, and formatted citations.

say_en.text: Here's my intro—help me make the hook stronger.
say_en.note: Analyzes the current hook and offers alternatives.
